Your KaleidoBrands hero installer is ready

Download the KaleidoBrands Hero Installer

Python script · Includes the four-slide carousel, responsive CSS, JavaScript, and Django integration.

How to install it

Download the script into your KaleidoBrands project directory, alongside manage.py. Then run:

Bash
python install_kaleidobrands_hero.py
python manage.py check
python manage.py runserver

The installer creates timestamped backups of the three existing files it edits.

Weekly images

For Slide 2, place your branded images in:

brands/static/brands/images/hero-weekly/

Use Monday dates as filenames, for example 2026-11-02.webp. The website will select the latest eligible image automatically. You'll need to deploy the new image files to your production website.

For Slide 4, seasonal images go into:

brands/static/brands/images/hero-seasonal/

Use filenames such as thanksgiving.webp, holiday.webp, or spring.webp. Until those images are supplied, the slide displays its seasonal message over a gradient background.

Important details

Slide 3 currently selects the three newest active products with images. That means new products imported by your weekly supplier sync can enter the rotation automatically. It does not yet enforce a strict per-sync batch replacement rule; that would require additional synchronization tracking.

The installer also uses your existing KaleidoBrands logo as a separate visual element. It does not automatically imprint the logo onto stock photographs.

I have prepared and syntax-checked the installer, but have not run it against your local Django project. Please run python manage.py check and test the homepage locally before deploying. No files on your Mac have been changed by me.
